name: svg-french-press-glm-5.3-flashx-v2-s2-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 1000" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe3ea"/>
      <stop offset="0.25" stop-color="#f2fafc"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#dceef3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9c6d1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8b8f94"/>
      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#d9dde1"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#b6babf"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7d8186"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="darkmetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#55585c"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#9fa4a9"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#7c8085"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4a4d51"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mesh" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c8ccd1"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9aa0a6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="meshpat" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="8" height="8" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
      <path d="M0 0H8M0 4H8M0 0V8M4 0V8" stroke="#6d7278" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.55"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect width="700" height="1000" fill="#f7f5f0"/>
  <text x="350" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" fill="#333" letter-spacing="2">FRENCH PRESS — EXPLODED ASSEMBLY</text>

  <!-- guide line -->
  <line x1="350" y1="90" x2="350" y2="960" stroke="#c9c4b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>

  <!-- ================= KNOB ================= -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="110" rx="34" ry="16" fill="url(#darkmetal)"/>
    <path d="M316 110 a34 16 0 0 1 68 0 l-8 20 a26 12 0 0 1 -52 0 z" fill="url(#darkmetal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="110" rx="20" ry="9" fill="#8e9296" opacity="0.5"/>
    <text x="430" y="118" font-size="15" fill="#444">Knob</text>
    <line x1="386" y1="115" x2="422" y2="115" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= PLUNGER ROD ================= -->
  <g>
    <rect x="344" y="140" width="12" height="300" rx="4" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="150" r="10" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <text x="430" y="300" font-size="15" fill="#444">Plunger rod</text>
    <line x1="360" y1="295" x2="422" y2="295" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= THREE-PIECE FILTER STACK ================= -->
  <!-- top spiral plate -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="470" rx="90" ry="22" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="466" rx="90" ry="22" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="466" rx="70" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#6f747a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="466" rx="48" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="#6f747a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="466" rx="26" ry="6.5" fill="none" stroke="#6f747a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="340" y="444" width="20" height="24" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <text x="480" y="468" font-size="15" fill="#444">Spiral cross plate (top)</text>
    <line x1="444" y1="464" x2="472" y2="464" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- spring disc -->
  <g>
    <path d="M275 528 q10 -16 22 0 q10 16 22 0 q10 -16 22 0 q10 16 22 0 q10 -16 22 0 q10 16 22 0 q10 -16 22 0 q10 16 22 0 l0 16 q-10 16 -22 0 q-10 -16 -22 0 q-10 16 -22 0 q-10 -16 -22 0 q-10 16 -22 0 q-10 -16 -22 0 q-10 16 -22 0 q-10 -16 -22 0 z"
          fill="none" stroke="#8a8f95" stroke-width="4" transform="translate(0,-10)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="530" rx="88" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#8a8f95" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="480" y="536" font-size="15" fill="#444">Spring disc (middle)</text>
    <line x1="442" y1="532" x2="472" y2="532" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- mesh screen -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="590" rx="90" ry="20" fill="url(#meshpat)" stroke="#6d7278" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="584" rx="90" ry="20" fill="url(#meshpat)" stroke="#6d7278" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="480" y="594" font-size="15" fill="#444">Mesh screen (bottom)</text>
    <line x1="444" y1="590" x2="472" y2="590" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= LID ================= -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="660" rx="108" ry="26" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#7d8186"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="654" rx="108" ry="26" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="654" rx="96" ry="23" fill="none" stroke="#8f949a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="343" y="600" width="14" height="40" rx="3" fill="url(#metal)"/>
    <text x="480" y="660" font-size="15" fill="#444">Lid with rod guide</text>
    <line x1="462" y1="655" x2="500" y2="655" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="480" y="678" font-size="13" fill="#777">(with pouring spout)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= CARAFE ================= -->
  <g>
    <path d="M262 700
             L262 730
             C262 760 240 780 240 830
             C240 900 290 930 350 930
             C410 930 460 900 460 830
             C460 780 438 760 438 730
             L438 700 Z"
          fill="url(#glass)" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="#8fb0bc" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- coffee inside -->
    <path d="M268 795
             C268 858 302 914 350 914
             C398 914 432 858 432 795 Z" fill="#5b3a26"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="795" rx="82" ry="9" fill="#6f4930"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M438 706 L470 718 L438 726 Z" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#8fb0bc" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M262 715 C212 722 202 790 226 845 C236 866 250 878 262 882"
          fill="none" stroke="url(#darkmetal)" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- highlight -->
    <path d="M285 740 C283 790 272 810 274 850" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="520" y="810" font-size="15" fill="#444">Glass carafe</text>
    <line x1="452" y1="805" x2="512" y2="805" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= FRAME / CAGE hint ================= -->
  <g opacity="0.95">
    <path d="M245 706 L245 700 M455 706 L455 700" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="520" y="880" font-size="13" fill="#777">Handle & frame</text>
    <text x="520" y="898" font-size="13" fill="#777">attach to carafe</text>
  </g>

  <!-- assembly order note -->
  <text x="60" y="950" font-size="13" fill="#888">Assembly order (top to bottom): knob → rod → spiral plate → spring disc → mesh screen → lid → carafe</text>
</svg>
